title: Redmi Watch 4: Big AMOLED Display, GPS & Long Battery Life
excerpt: Discover the Xiaomi Redmi Watch 4, a feature-packed smartwatch with a large 1.97-inch AMOLED display and built-in GPS, now available in Kenya. Learn how its extended battery life and comprehensive fitness tracking can enhance your daily routine.
content:
Introduction

Smartwatches have become more than just time-telling devices; they are personal health coaches, communication hubs, and style statements. Xiaomi's Redmi series consistently offers compelling value, and the Redmi Watch 4 continues this tradition. This latest iteration aims to deliver a premium smartwatch experience without the premium price tag, focusing on a large, vibrant display, extensive fitness tracking, and robust battery life. For users in Kenya looking for a capable wearable that handles everything from daily notifications to outdoor runs, the Redmi Watch 4 presents itself as a strong contender.

Whether you're tracking your morning jog through Nairobi's estates or monitoring your heart rate during a busy workday, a reliable smartwatch is essential. The Redmi Watch 4 integrates key features like multi-system GNSS for accurate location tracking and Bluetooth calling, ensuring you stay connected and informed wherever you are in Kenya. We'll dive into what makes this watch a practical choice for everyday use.

Key Specifications

Feature Detail
Display 1.97" AMOLED, 60Hz Refresh Rate
GNSS (GPS) GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BDS (Multi-system)
Sensors Heart Rate, SpO2, Accelerometer
Battery Life Up to 20 Days (Typical Usage)
Connectivity Bluetooth 5.3
Water Resistance 5ATM (50 meters)
Sports Modes 150+

Design & Build

The first thing you notice about the Redmi Watch 4 is its generous 1.97-inch AMOLED display. This screen size provides ample space for notifications, workout metrics, and watch faces, making interactions more comfortable. The AMOLED panel delivers vibrant colours and deep blacks, which is typical of the technology, and the 60Hz refresh rate ensures smooth scrolling and responsiveness. The bright display remains easily readable even under Kenya's often intense sunlight, a practical consideration for outdoor activities.

Xiaomi has opted for a design that balances aesthetics with durability. The watch body feels robust, and the interchangeable straps allow for personalization to match your style or activity. With 5ATM water resistance, the Redmi Watch 4 is suitable for swimming or accidental splashes, providing peace of mind during various daily scenarios. The overall build quality suggests a device designed for regular use.

Performance

Underneath its sleek exterior, the Redmi Watch 4 is packed with features designed to enhance your daily life. The built-in multi-system GNSS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BDS) is a significant advantage, allowing for precise tracking of outdoor activities like running or cycling without needing to carry your phone. This accuracy is particularly useful when exploring new routes or simply wanting a reliable record of your workout in places like Karura Forest or along the Mombasa Road.

With over 150 sports modes, the watch caters to a wide range of physical activities, from common exercises to more niche sports. Health monitoring features include continuous heart rate tracking, SpO2 (blood oxygen) monitoring, and sleep tracking, providing a comprehensive overview of your well-being. The inclusion of Bluetooth 5.3 ensures stable connectivity with your smartphone, enabling features like Bluetooth calling directly from your wrist, which is convenient when your phone is out of reach or you're on the move.

Battery life is often a critical factor for smartwatches, and the Redmi Watch 4 truly shines here, boasting up to 20 days of typical usage. This extended battery life means less time charging and more time using the watch, a practical benefit for anyone with a busy schedule in Kenya, reducing the concern of the watch dying midway through the day or a multi-day trip. Even with heavy use, you can expect several days of power.

Verdict

The Xiaomi Redmi Watch 4 offers a compelling package for its price point. Its large, bright AMOLED display, accurate multi-system GNSS, extensive sports tracking, and impressive battery life make it a highly practical and desirable smartwatch for users in Kenya. The ability to make Bluetooth calls from the wrist and its robust build quality further enhance its appeal.

If you're seeking a feature-rich smartwatch that delivers reliable performance for both fitness and daily notifications, without breaking the bank, the Redmi Watch 4 is an excellent choice. It’s a device that balances advanced functionality with user-friendliness, making it a valuable addition to your tech ecosystem. Trivo Kenya recommends this watch for its solid performance and outstanding value.
